common questions

Before You Reach Out

How quickly will I hear back?
  • Your local Bloomin’ Blinds owner will respond within one business day. Most owners respond the same day.
Is the consultation really free?
  • Yes. Every in-home design consultation is completely free with no obligation. Your local owner brings samples, measures your space, and provides a written quote at no cost.
Can I get a quote without an in-home visit?
  • For the most accurate quote, we recommend an in-home consult so we can see your windows, light, and space. However, your local owner can discuss general pricing and options over the phone to help you plan.
What if there is no Bloomin’ Blinds location near me?
  • We are growing and adding new locations regularly. Submit the form above and we will let you know if service is available in your area. You can also check our location finder for the nearest team.
